metadata.selection: Pretrained DUSt3R (224) was run on up to 20,000 candidate pairs per dataset (seed 42) with at least 5% co-visibility. The pairs with the highest relative rotation error were kept: 1,000 for DTU and ETH3D, 300 for 7Scenes, NRGBD and ScanNetv2 (2,900 candidates). 300 were sampled uniformly from the same random.Random(42) stream after the In-Distribution draw.

fields.image1_path: path relative to the Out-of-Distribution data root (docs/datasets.md)
fields.dust3r_rre: pretrained DUSt3R relative rotation error (degrees), the selection statistic
